title: [ORION-QG QG-7e] Close single-pinner PP comm-s2 sector over the full hidden-home environment
body:
Parent programme: #740
Direct parent: QG-7d information closure #836 / PR #860.
State diagnosis: QG-22 #868 / PR #869 (dual-harness GREEN; hidden-home J5 delta admits an exact compact state quotient).
Sibling theorem: QG-7d J7 PA confirmatory PR #870 (dual-harness GREEN; PA all-n closed, PP/chain open).

## Status

**PROSPECTIVE CONFIRMATORY PP NORMALIZATION PACKET — freeze the full hidden environment before official dual-harness outcome.**

QG-7d's original T4b theorem attempt left the pinned comm-s2 sector open. The exact split is now sharper:

- PA single-pinner sector: 103,048 parent failures, closed all-n by J7.
- PP single-pinner sector: 32,556 visible T4b failures; QG-7d information closure proved the parent quotient omitted a load-bearing phantom-home environment of `4^6=4096` assignments.
- chain sector: two pinning blocks and/or a comm-s2 pinner remain separately declared open and are NOT part of QG-7e.

QG-7e asks whether every one of the `32,556 × 4,096 = 133,349,376` complete single-pinner PP environments normalizes non-increasingly using only already-earned parent moves, support-one D+, and enlarged borrow B′.

No new family is invented in V1.

## Disclosed exploratory derivation before freeze

The official packet is confirmatory. The following corrected values were obtained during exploratory derivation and are now frozen/falsifiable:

1. Complete PP visible parent reproduction: **32,556** failures with histogram `32,116×(+1), 440×(+2)`.
2. Full hidden-home domain: **4,096** assignments; total product domain **133,349,376**.
3. A frozen **576-member** global all-support-one relocation library — 3 relocation coordinates × 3 Tag letters × `2^3` label-1 frame choices × `2^3` target permutations — combined with the already-earned parent G1–G4 moves leaves exactly **6,488** positive environments, all `+1`.
4. Exact full D+ / support<=1 family on those 6,488 leaves exactly **24** positive rows. Exact `C_Dplus - C_reference` histogram:
   - `-2: 136`
   - `-1: 3,676`
   - `0: 2,652`
   - `+1: 24`.
5. Exact unchanged QG-5b B′ on exactly those 24 gives **-1 on all 24**. Final residual = **0**.

Two exploratory implementation mistakes were detected and discarded **before protocol freeze** and have no authority:
- the hidden tuple was initially assembled as block-interleaved instead of the correct `(a0,b0,c0,a1,b1,c1)` order;
- an intermediate relocation calculation optimized visible target permutations independently of the hidden coordinate, even though the permutation tuple is global.

Those provisional counts (`5,376 / 302 / 50` and later `8,468 / 24`) are explicitly excluded. QG-7e must reproduce only the corrected `6,488 -> 24 -> 0` chain above.

## Q1 — complete visible PP parent reconstruction

Rebuild the exact QG-7c PP G1–G4 tensor from primitive/production local algebra, not from a serialized failure list. Required:
- 32,556 visible failures;
- `32,116×(+1), 440×(+2)`;
- exact parameter-cell fingerprint bound to QG-7c;
- same visible state fields as QG-7d information closure.

## Q2 — complete hidden-home composition

Use hidden tuple order exactly:

`(a0,b0,c0,a1,b1,c1)`

where branch 0 maps `(a0,b0,c0)` to blocks A/B/C and branch 1 maps `(a1,b1,c1)`.

The pinned PP reference at the hidden home has pinner frame letters `Z` on branch 0 and `X` on branch 1. Reproduce QG-7d information-closure hidden domain exactly.

## Q3 — frozen 576 relocation screen

For each full visible+hidden environment, test all support-one whole-system relocations:
- relocation coordinate `q in {b,a,home}`;
- shared Tag letter `s in {X,Y,Z}` at q;
- each block's label-1 frame letter chosen from the two letters anticommuting with s;
- one **global** target-permutation tuple `(sigma_A,sigma_B,sigma_C) in {0,1}^3`, applied consistently at every coordinate;
- structural cost exactly 2 (weight-one Tag, all support-one frames).

Combine with the exact parent G1–G4 bound. The factorized implementation may minimize visible/hidden coordinate costs separately **only while conditioning on the same frozen global sigma tuple**.

Frozen expected residual: **6,488**, all `+1`.

## Q4 — exact full D+ on the residual only

On the 6,488 residual full n=3 target instances, compute the exact support<=1 family:
- shared Tag may have arbitrary nonzero support over all three coordinates;
- every block's two anticommuting frame generators are support one at one coordinate where the Tag is nonzero;
- exact target permutation per block;
- exact F3 Restore accounting;
- exact Tag cost `2*wt(S)`;
- support-one frame extra cost zero.

A canonical label orientation may be used only with a proved symmetry/bijection; generic ORION must independently reconstruct the complete family.

Frozen exact configuration count under the canonical orientation: **61,056** templates.

Frozen expected D+ residual histogram: `{-2:136,-1:3676,0:2652,+1:24}`.

## Q5 — exact B′ handoff

Evaluate unchanged committed QG-5b B′ only on the 24 exact D+ residuals, using all three target coordinates including the hidden home. Every selected production B′ witness must pass `verify_bprime_witness`.

Frozen expectation: all 24 have `B′ - C_reference = -1`; zero final residual.

No B″, B‴, or post-outcome family widening is allowed in V1.

## Q6 — theorem composition / authority boundary

A positive QG-7e result proves only:

> The **single non-comm-s2 pinner PP sector** of the QG-7c pinned comm-s2 normalization closes over the complete hidden-home environment under the frozen unit objective, using already-earned parent moves/D+/B′.

Together with J7 it closes both single-pinner PA and single-pinner PP sectors. It does **not** close:
- two simultaneous pinning blocks;
- a pinner that is itself comm-s2;
- mutually pinned multi-comm-s2 chains;
- global B″ completeness/all-n TARE closed form until those chain obligations close.

## Dual harness

Generic ORION must independently rebuild:
- phase-free Pauli multiplication/symplectic/F3;
- complete PP G1–G4 visible domain;
- correct hidden tuple mapping;
- the globally consistent 576 relocation library;
- the exact 61,056-template D+ family;
- exact B′ on the 24 residuals without importing the production QG-5b helper.

Native ORION-Q must bind the QG-7c/QG-7d/QG-22/J7 lineage and keep `PP_SINGLE_PINNER_ALL_N`, `CHAIN_ALL_N`, and `GLOBAL_BDOUBLEPRIME_COMPLETENESS` distinct.

## Honest terminals

- `QG7E_PP_SINGLE_PINNER_CLOSED_ALL_HIDDEN_ENVIRONMENTS__CHAIN_OPEN`
- `QG7E_RELOCATION_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH`
- `QG7E_DPLUS_RESIDUAL_MISMATCH`
- `QG7E_BPRIME_HANDOFF_REFUTED__RESIDUAL_REMAINS`
- `QG7E_GENERIC_NATIVE_DISAGREEMENT`
- `QG7E_PARENT_BINDING_GAP`
- `QG7E_CANNOT_CHECK`

## Claim boundary

No novelty credit for finite enumeration, dynamic programming, support-capped optimization, state quotienting, or the already-earned D+/B′ families. No R6 or physical quantum advantage. Protected stretched-N2 remains sealed.

nodes.body: QG-7e V1 protected run 32560168955 / job 97000434954 is an honest **CANNOT_CHECK**, not a theorem. Analyzer, generic ORION, native ORION-Q and deterministic replay all completed, but the positive authority gate failed because `reference_witnesses_verified=false` on all 24 final rows. Root cause localized after the run: QG-7c T4b `envB/envA` entries are residual-space letters. V1's visible target realization missed the residual->raw-target conversion `t3_0b = v0b * Z` in the `ja=1` third-block branch-0 case. Thus V1's provisional full-instance cost fingerprints cannot be promoted even though its internal D+ and B′ calculations agreed. No V1 gate/protocol will be weakened or patched post-outcome. A fresh V2 will freeze only after recomputing the complete domain under the corrected parent residual->target bijection. V1 authority remains `PP_SINGLE_PINNER_ALL_N=false`, `CHAIN_ALL_N=false`, global B″ false.

V2 residual-binding exploratory run 32560548231 / artifact 9472659916 completed with **zero reference-witness failures**, confirming the corrected parent residual->raw-target bijection. Authoritative corrected fingerprints from the uploaded JSON (not the invalid V1 counts): complete product 133,349,376; parent+576 relocation residual **5,684**, all +1; exact D+ histogram `{-2:132,-1:2456,0:2716,+1:380}` with 380 residuals and all production D+ controls agreeing; exact full B′ gives **-1 on all 380**, final residual 0. V1 remains CANNOT_CHECK and unchanged. A fresh V2 confirmatory protocol will now freeze exactly `32,556 -> 5,684 -> 380 -> 0`, correct target binding, and zero reference failures before official dual-harness execution.

**QG-7e V2 corrected-binding confirmation is GREEN.** Draft PR #876, workflow `32561308132`: analyzer, independent generic ORION, native ORION-Q, deterministic replay and frozen authority gates all passed. Correct protected chain: `32,556 visible PP failures x 4,096 hidden homes = 133,349,376` complete environments; 576 relocation screen -> `5,684` (+1 only); exact 61,056-template D+ -> histogram `{-2:132,-1:2456,0:2716,+1:380}` and `380` residuals; exact B' -> `-1` on all 380, final residual `0`. Terminal `QG7E_V2_PP_SINGLE_PINNER_CLOSED_ALL_HIDDEN_ENVIRONMENTS__CHAIN_OPEN`. This supersedes the invalid V1 exploratory `6,488->24->0` fingerprint, which remains preserved as a failed binding attempt. `PP_SINGLE_PINNER_ALL_N=true`; chain/global B'' completeness remain false. Protected result receipt committed at `research/extensions/orion-qg/QG7E_V2_PP_SINGLE_PINNER_RESULTS.json`.
